diagnosis: Mixed medullary and follicular cell–derived thyroid carcinoma
legend: Tumour analysed using targeted next-generation sequencing after manual microdissection of medullary carcinoma–predominant (MTC, brown box) and papillary carcinoma with follicular/solid growth–predominant (FOLL, red box) areas.
